name: Question 48
worked_solution:
In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)=\operatorname{coth}⁡x$ and $v(x)=3{x}^{3}.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{(\operatorname{coth}⁡x)}^{′}\cdot 3{x}^{3}-\operatorname{coth}⁡x\cdot {(3{x}^{3})}^{′}}{{(3{x}^{3})}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{-3{x}^{3}{csch}^{2}⁡x-9{x}^{2}\operatorname{coth}⁡x}{9{x}^{6}} \\  & =-\frac{3{x}^{2}(x{csch}^{2}⁡x+3\operatorname{coth}⁡x)}{9{x}^{6}} \\  & =-\frac{x{csch}^{2}⁡x+3\operatorname{coth}⁡x}{3{x}^{4}}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 48
?

Find the derivative of f(x)=coth⁡x3x3.

a
 −xcsch2⁡x+3coth⁡x3x4
b
xcsch2⁡x−3coth⁡x3x4
c
 −coth⁡x(xcsch⁡x+3)9x4
d
coth⁡x(xcsch⁡x−3)9x4

 −xcsch2⁡x+3coth⁡x3x3

Submit

EXPLANATION

In this case, the expression for f(x) is a quotient u(x)v(x) with u(x)=coth⁡x and v(x)=3x3.

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

f′(x)=u′(x)⋅v(x)−u(x)⋅v′(x)[v(x)]2=(coth⁡x)′⋅3x3−coth⁡x⋅(3x3)′(3x3)2=−3x3csch2⁡x−9x2coth⁡x9x6=−3x2(xcsch2⁡x+3coth⁡x)9x6=−xcsch2⁡x+3coth⁡x3x4
